title: Automated Multi-Line Bug Repair Using Model Checker Aided LLMs: A Case Study on RISC-V Processors
title_zh: 基于模型检测器辅助大语言模型的自动化多行缺陷修复：RISC-V处理器案例研究

paragraphs.en: Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level (RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resources. Debugging, in particular, remains an especially time-consuming task, requiring careful analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples. Recent work has explored applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to RTL debug and repair with great promise. However, the existing approaches typically are for single-line bugs, operate in open-loop, rely heavily on prompts or retrieval, lack scalability, and often produce incorrect fixes. In this paper, we propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology that combines LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to provide scalable, trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees. Concretely, the methodology leverages failing assertions to guide the LLM in generating patches for multi-line bugs. Each candidate patch is formally verified using a model checker (JasperGold), ensuring only valid repairs are accepted. We evaluate the efficacy and scalability of our methodology on the BRISC-V RISC-V core using mutation testing, introducing several mutation types, and demonstrate that our methodology can repair up to 98 % 98\% of single-line RTL bugs and 93% of the multi-line bugs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to show automated, LLM-assisted RTL multi-line bug repair results on a complex RISC-V processor design in a scalable manner.

paragraphs.en: Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level (RTL) designs has emerged as a principal bottleneck in the semiconductor development process, often consuming up to 70% of overall project resources [ 1 , 2 ] . This growing burden is largely driven by the increasing complexity and functional richness of modern digital systems, which incorporate deep pipelines, multiple interacting sub-systems, and a variety of protocols and timing constraints. As designs scale in size and sophistication, the verification effort required to ensure correctness and safety has grown disproportionately. Among the various verification tasks, debugging, i.e., identifying and correcting functional errors in Hardware Description Language (HDL) code remains particularly time-consuming. It often requires manual analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples, and demands a detailed understanding of both the design intent and implementation [ 3 , 4 ] .

paragraphs.en: In recent times, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown success in software engineering tasks such as code generation and automated program repair. This success has motivated research on applying LLMs to hardware design tasks [ 5 , 6 ] , with studies exploring RTL code generation [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , security bug fixes [ 10 ] , and syntax error correction [ 11 , 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近来，大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成和自动程序修复等软件工程任务中已展现出成功。 这一成功推动了将大语言模型应用于硬件设计任务的研究 [ 5 , 6 ] ，相关研究探索了 RTL 代码生成 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] 、安全漏洞修复 [ 10 ] 以及语法错误纠正 [ 11 , 12 ] 。

sents.en: In recent times, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown success in software engineering tasks such as code generation and automated program repair.
sents.zh: 近来，大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成和自动程序修复等软件工程任务中已展现出成功。

sents.en: This success has motivated research on applying LLMs to hardware design tasks [ 5 , 6 ] , with studies exploring RTL code generation [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , security bug fixes [ 10 ] , and syntax error correction [ 11 , 12 ] .

paragraphs.en: In particular, a number of recent research articles have reported efforts on using LLMs to generate SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) from various inputs such as natural-language specifications, source code comments, or even the RTL code itself [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] . Frameworks like AssertLLM and Spec2Assertion translate design specifications into formal properties, easing the burden of writing assertions manually [ 18 , 19 ] . Other research has demonstrated iterative, human-in-the-loop flows where feedback from a formal verification tool is used to refine LLM-generated assertions [ 20 ] , using techniques like Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Chain-Of-Thought (COT), and agentic frameworks [ 21 , 22 ] . Although these advances streamline the creation of verification artifacts, they do not directly address the task of repairing a buggy RTL.
paragraphs.zh: 特别地，近期已有多篇研究论文报告了利用大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言规范、源代码注释甚至RTL代码本身等各种输入生成SystemVerilog断言（SVA）的相关工作[13, 14, 15, 16, 17]。 诸如AssertLLM和Spec2Assertion等框架将设计规范转换为形式化属性，减轻了手工编写断言的负担[18, 19]。 另一些研究则展示了迭代式的人机协同流程，即利用形式化验证工具的反馈来改进大语言模型生成的断言[20]，并采用了检索增强生成（RAG）、思维链（COT）以及基于智能体的框架等技术[21, 22]。 尽管这些进展简化了验证产物的创建过程，但它们并未直接解决修复有缺陷RTL代码的任务。

paragraphs.en: There have been recent attempts to repair RTL using LLM-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: 最近已有一些尝试使用基于大语言模型的方法来修复 RTL。

paragraphs.en: AssertSolver [ 23 ] trains an LLM on a large synthetic dataset of bugs, failure logs, and fixes, enabling it to predict code patches from a given assertion failure log. These methods can suggest plausible fixes, but rely on a static pre-trained model and perform the repair in a single pass. The HDLdebugger framework introduces a retrieval-augmented fine-tuning approach, and along with HDL documents, the LLM takes the buggy code, its error message, task prompt, and code RAG, and the edit distance between the correct code and the buggy code is their evaluation metric [ 24 ] . Other bug-patching strategies [ 25 , 26 ] employ an iterative “bug closure” process using RAG to incorporate design specifications. If the initially retrieved context is insufficient, these methods repeatedly pull in more specification content or code context and re-prompt the LLM. This iterative method can eventually find a fix for up to 60% of the reported bugs.
paragraphs.zh: AssertSolver [ 23 ] 在一个由缺陷、失败日志和修复组成的大型合成数据集上训练大语言模型，使其能够根据给定的断言失败日志预测代码补丁。 这些方法可以给出看似合理的修复建议，但依赖于静态的预训练模型，并且只通过单次处理完成修复。 HDLdebugger 框架提出了一种检索增强的微调方法，除了 HDL 文档之外，大语言模型还会接收有缺陷的代码、其错误信息、任务提示以及代码 RAG，并以正确代码与有缺陷代码之间的编辑距离作为其评估指标 [ 24 ] 。 其他缺陷修复策略 [ 25 , 26 ] 采用迭代的“缺陷闭环”流程，利用 RAG 引入设计规范。 如果最初检索到的上下文不够充分，这些方法会反复拉取更多规范内容或代码上下文，并重新提示大语言模型。 这种迭代方法最终可以为多达 60% 的已报告缺陷找到修复方案。

paragraphs.en: Contribution: We propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology for both single and multi-line bugs that uses LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to synthesise bug patches on a complex RISC-V processor in a scalable manner. More concretely, the goal is to leverage the semantic structure of assertions and the output of a model checker to build a context for the LLM, so that it can propose an accurate fix. Consequently, it provides a trustworthy grounding and formal guarantees as the model checker provides an objective oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献：我们提出了一种新颖的自动化 RTL 缺陷修复方法，可处理单行和多行缺陷，该方法利用大语言模型、断言和模型检测器，以可扩展的方式在复杂的 RISC-V 处理器上综合生成缺陷补丁。 更具体地说，其目标是利用断言的语义结构和模型检测器的输出来为大语言模型构建上下文，使其能够提出准确的修复方案。 因此，由于模型检测器提供了客观的判定基准，该方法提供了可信的基础和形式化保证。

paragraphs.en: To this end, our methodology is two-fold:
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们的方法是双方面的：

paragraphs.en: First, the user asks the LLM to generate the patch only from the buggy code. Second, we provide the failing assertions in addition to the buggy code to aid in the correction process. In both steps, the proposed patch is always formally verified using a model checker. For scalability, we conducted an extensive set of experiments on BRISC-V [ 27 ] where we took advantage of mutation testing [ 28 ] . Mutation testing allows for a comprehensive assessment of the quality and thoroughness of the verification process by introducing controlled modifications in the given design. We study 10 10 mutation classes. 9 9 mutations from the existing literature and 1 1 new mutation, which injects an “if-else” indentation bug [ 26 ] . We inject the mutations in the RTL using LLM. Our proposed method was able to fix upto 98 % 98\% of the single-line bugs and 93 % 93\% of the multi-line bugs certified by the model checker. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to present an automated LLM-assisted repair result on a complex RISC-V processor code. Our contributions are summarized below:
paragraphs.zh: 首先，用户要求大语言模型仅根据有缺陷的代码生成补丁。 其次，我们在有缺陷的代码之外还提供失败的断言，以辅助修复过程。 在这两个步骤中，所提出的补丁始终通过模型检查器进行形式化验证。 为了评估可扩展性，我们在 BRISC-V [ 27 ] 上进行了大量实验，并利用了变异测试 [ 28 ]。 变异测试通过在给定设计中引入受控修改，能够全面评估验证过程的质量和彻底性。 我们研究了 10 10 个变异类别，其中 9 9 个来自现有文献，1 1 个是新提出的变异，该变异注入“if-else”缩进错误 [ 26 ]。 我们使用大语言模型将变异注入 RTL。 我们提出的方法能够修复经模型检查器认证的 98 % 98\% 的单行错误和 93 % 93\% 的多行错误。 据我们所知，这是首个在复杂 RISC-V 处理器代码上展示自动化大语言模型辅助修复结果的工作。 我们的贡献总结如下：

sents.en: First, the user asks the LLM to generate the patch only from the buggy code.
sents.zh: 首先，用户要求大语言模型仅根据有缺陷的代码生成补丁。

sents.en: Second, we provide the failing assertions in addition to the buggy code to aid in the correction process.
sents.zh: 其次，我们在有缺陷的代码之外还提供失败的断言，以辅助修复过程。

sents.en: In both steps, the proposed patch is always formally verified using a model checker.
sents.zh: 在这两个步骤中，所提出的补丁始终通过模型检查器进行形式化验证。

sents.en: For scalability, we conducted an extensive set of experiments on BRISC-V [ 27 ] where we took advantage of mutation testing [ 28 ] .
sents.zh: 为了评估可扩展性，我们在 BRISC-V [ 27 ] 上进行了大量实验，并利用了变异测试 [ 28 ]。

sents.en: Mutation testing allows for a comprehensive assessment of the quality and thoroughness of the verification process by introducing controlled modifications in the given design.
sents.zh: 变异测试通过在给定设计中引入受控修改，能够全面评估验证过程的质量和彻底性。

sents.en: We study 10 10 mutation classes. 9 9 mutations from the existing literature and 1 1 new mutation, which injects an “if-else” indentation bug [ 26 ] .
sents.zh: 我们研究了 10 10 个变异类别，其中 9 9 个来自现有文献，1 1 个是新提出的变异，该变异注入“if-else”缩进错误 [ 26 ]。

sents.en: We inject the mutations in the RTL using LLM.
sents.zh: 我们使用大语言模型将变异注入 RTL。

sents.en: Our proposed method was able to fix upto 98 % 98\% of the single-line bugs and 93 % 93\% of the multi-line bugs certified by the model checker.
sents.zh: 我们提出的方法能够修复经模型检查器认证的 98 % 98\% 的单行错误和 93 % 93\% 的多行错误。

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to present an automated LLM-assisted repair result on a complex RISC-V processor code.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个在复杂 RISC-V 处理器代码上展示自动化大语言模型辅助修复结果的工作。

sents.en: Our contributions are summarized below:

paragraphs.en: We propose a novel LLM-assisted automated RTL bug repair approach with assertions and a model checker in the loop, which provides trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的基于大语言模型（LLM）辅助的自动化 RTL 缺陷修复方法，该方法将断言和模型检查器纳入闭环，从而提供可信的语义基础和形式化保证。

paragraphs.en: The methodology successfully fixes single-line and multi-line bugs, where the bug could be anywhere in the procedural blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法能够成功修复单行和多行缺陷，且缺陷可能位于过程块中的任意位置。

paragraphs.en: We experiment using mutation testing with a set of 10 10 mutation classes on an open source RISC-V IP, on different modules with a mix of auto-generated and hand-written assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用变异测试，在一个开源 RISC-V IP 上，针对包含自动生成与手写断言混合的不同模块，采用 10 组共 10 个变异类别进行了实验。

paragraphs.en: We implement an immediate prior art [ 26 ] (referred to as Stage 1 in our experiments) on LLM-aided RTL repair, and provide comparative results. As seen from our experiments, the presence of assertions indeed helps the fixing task.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present a small example with a bug in RTL to highlight the problem in using open-loop methods, which do not have trustworthy grounding. The example is a code snippet from the Cache Coherence Controller (CCC) module inside BRISC-V. The CCC typically implements one of the cache coherence protocols to ensure coherence and consistency of data shared across multiple cores [ 29 ] . In the BRISC-V core used in this work, the MESI protocol is implemented. In particular, the CCC code describes a finite state machine highlighting the different states of the snoop operation, with 7 7 different states and respective transitions. This module has an assertion suite consisting of 56 56 concurrent assertions, all of which evaluate to true when run using the model checker JasperGold [ 30 ] . We inject a conditional bug by inverting the "if conditional" statement. The original code was "if (hit) begin" and after the bug injection, it was changed to "if (!hit) begin" .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们展示一个带 RTL 缺陷的小例子，以突出使用开环方法的问题，这类方法缺乏可信的依据。 该例子是 BRISC-V 内部缓存一致性控制器（CCC）模块的一段代码片段。 CCC 通常实现某种缓存一致性协议，以确保多个核心间共享数据的一致性与相干性 [ 29 ] 。 在本工作所使用的 BRISC-V 核心中，实现的是 MESI 协议。 具体而言，CCC 代码描述了一个有限状态机，突出嗅探操作的不同状态，共有 7 7 个不同状态及相应的状态转换。 该模块包含一个由 56 56 条并发断言组成的断言套件，在使用模型检查器 JasperGold [ 30 ] 运行时，所有断言的求值结果均为真。 我们通过将 “if conditional” 语句取反来注入一个条件缺陷。 原代码为 “if (hit) begin”，注入缺陷后被改为 “if (!hit) begin”。

paragraphs.en: In response to Prompt 1, the LLM was unable to identify the correct patch and produced a hallucination, as shown in Reply 1. This happened despite the simple nature of the single-line bug. This highlights the limitation of only using the LLM for bug fixing. Prior works have shown that some of the bugs can be corrected by iteratively prompting the LLM. However, the approach is still non-deterministic and can require an arbitrary number of iterations. paragraphs.en: This section presents our LLM-assisted automated RTL bug repair methodology with assertions and a model checker in the loop, which provides trustworthy grounding and formal guarantees. Fig. 1 shows a high-level workflow of our proposed methodology, which takes in RTL code and a set of assertions and carries out 2 2 steps. First, we take the assertions and pass them to JasperGold, which runs the assertions on the code and produces the set of Failed Assertions. The second phase consists of 2 2 stages, Stage 1 : the LLM is asked to repair the buggy code without any additional context. If the bug is not repaired, then in Stage 2 : the set of failed assertions is provided to the LLM in addition to the code, and it is asked to repair the code. If the bug is repaired, then ”Code Repaired” is reported, and if the bug is not repaired after Stage 2 , ”Code not repaired” is reported. We now elaborate on each of the two Stages in detail.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍我们的借助大语言模型（LLM）的自动化 RTL 缺陷修复方法，该方法以断言和模型检测器作为流程环节，从而提供可信的依据和形式化保证。 图 1 展示了我们所提出方法的高层工作流程，该流程以 RTL 代码和一组断言作为输入，并执行 2 2 个步骤。 首先，我们获取断言并将其传递给 JasperGold，由其在代码上运行这些断言，并产生失败断言（Failed Assertions）集合。 第二阶段包含 2 2 个步骤，阶段 1：在不提供任何额外上下文的情况下，要求 LLM 修复有缺陷的代码。 如果缺陷未被修复，则在阶段 2 中：除了代码之外，还将失败断言集合提供给 LLM，并要求其修复代码。 如果缺陷已被修复，则报告“代码已修复”（Code Repaired）；如果经过阶段 2 后缺陷仍未被修复，则报告“代码未修复”（Code not repaired）。 下面我们详细阐述这两个阶段中的每一个阶段。

paragraphs.en: Given an RTL design ℛ {\mathcal{R}} , a set of assertions 𝒫 {\mathcal{P}} , and a set of bug types, our objective is to be able to localize the bugs of each of the given types and generate fixes with the help of an LLM and a formal verification tool. We assume the bugs can be in any single-line or across multiple-lines anywhere in the RTL code. Also, all assertions in the set 𝒫 {\mathcal{P}} hold on ℛ {\mathcal{R}} , when evaluated using the formal verifier, which evaluates an assertion on all possible scenarios before concluding a pass. Fig. 1 shows a high level workflow of our proposed methodology, comprising of 2 2 main Phases : 1) Phase-1: Assertion Status Check, and 2) Phase-2: Debugging.

paragraphs.en: Our repair phase comprises 2 2 Stages , as discussed below. After each Stage , the patches suggested by the LLMs are examined by the JasperGold tool. If all assertions pass, we conclude that the bugs have been repaired.

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: We first provide the mutated code, i.e., the buggy code, and ask the LLM to identify the bugs. The LLM is only provided with the information that the code has bugs, and we want to repair the bug. No additional information is provided at this Stage to the LLM. Each patch generated is examined through the formal verifier against the mutated code, and the number of Failed assertions are counted. If the number of Failed assertions is reduced, then it is considered a correct patch suggested by the LLM. This can happen as in multi-line bugs, as some of the bugs can be corrected, while for the others we may need to go to the Stage 2 . We proceed to the next step if the verifier reports that some assertions produce a violation leading to counterexamples.

If it is given a hardware design in SystemVerilog, it can detect the bug and patch it. With the role-playing setup, we try to improve responses aligned with assigned roles [ 33 ] . paragraphs.en: Assertions play a key role in our overall workflow. For some of the modules, assertions were manually generated, while for others, assertions were generated using an LLM in a different session. The important metric of the generated assertion is the formal coverage of the assertion suite, which gives confidence in the proof span of the assertions with respect to the code statements, states, transitions, and faults. Given an RTL model and a set of assertions, JasperGold provides this information to a verification engineer, which guides one in assertion IP development. We utilize this feature crucially in our work. If the assertion coverage is low, it may not always be possible to get failing assertions that can aid in localization. Also, it may be noted that the generation of high coverage assertion IPs is a challenge. One of the important concerns in not being able to reproduce the experiments reported in [ 26 ] is the lack of useful assertions for the OpenTitan [ 34 ] modules. Several LLM-assisted assertion generators report assertion generation capabilities on OpenTitan modules. In particular, we experimented with [ 17 ] and [ 20 ] , but our experience was negative. Most of the assertions either failed or passed without any trend, making it impractical for us to reproduce their work. Hence, in this work, we used all the assertions that were manually generated and were evaluated to be of high quality using JasperGold.

sents.zh: 所生成断言的重要指标是断言套件的形式化覆盖率，它使人们能够确信这些断言在证明范围上覆盖了代码语句、状态、迁移和故障。

paragraphs.en: We consider a set of 6 modules from the BRISC-V RTL code base. A procedural block of an RTL code specifies the behavioral property of the code. It comprises statements like assignment statements, conditional statements, and state transition statements. In all of the experiments, we consider always blocks, and in most cases of the chosen modules, the lines of code in each block are around 200-300 lines. This is typically representative of a situation where a designer can localize a given bug to a small region of code or an always block, but is unable to pinpoint it. This is also an advantage of the proposed methodology, as the prior work assumed that the line with the bug is known a priori [ 26 ] . Given that we have the assertions for the RTL, we could narrow down the region of the bug to 200-300 lines of code for all the introduced mutations. The details of the benchmark modules used for the evaluation are furnished in the following discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑来自 BRISC-V RTL 代码库的 6 个模块。 RTL 代码的过程块描述了该代码的行为特性。 它包含赋值语句、条件语句和状态转移语句等语句。 在所有实验中，我们考虑的是 always 块，并且在所选模块的大多数情况下，每个块中的代码行数约为 200-300 行。 这通常代表这样一种情形：设计者能够将给定的缺陷定位到一小段代码或一个 always 块中，但无法精确定位它。 这也是所提方法的一个优势，因为已有工作假定含有缺陷的行是先验已知的 [ 26 ] 。 鉴于我们拥有 RTL 的断言，对于所有引入的变异，我们都能将缺陷所在区域缩小到 200-300 行代码。 用于评估的基准模块的细节将在接下来的讨论中给出。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our methodology, we leverage mutation testing, where we create mutations of ℛ {\mathcal{R}} . These mutations act as bugs in our design. To ensure that the mutations in code lines are inserted at random locations, we use the LLM itself to create them. It has to be noted that the mutations are created in a separate session so that the LLM does not remember its history during the repair step. The mutations inserted in the correct code are syntax preserving, while semantically non-preserving [ 35 ] , which results in altering the functionality of the code that was captured in the correct assertions. As mentioned earlier, a single mutation is inserted in a single line of the RTL code, resulting in a semantic change that causes one or more of 𝒫 {\mathcal{P}} to be violated.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们方法的有效性，我们利用变异测试，对 ℛ {\mathcal{R}} 创建变异体。 这些变异体充当设计中的缺陷。 为了确保代码行中的变异体被插入到随机位置，我们使用大语言模型自身来创建它们。 需要注意的是，变异体是在单独的会话中创建的，这样大语言模型在修复步骤中就不会记住其历史记录。 插入到正确代码中的变异体是保持语法的，但不保持语义 [ 35 ] ，这会导致正确断言中所捕获的代码功能发生改变。 如前所述，单个变异体被插入到 RTL 代码的单行中，从而导致语义变化，使 𝒫 {\mathcal{P}} 中的一项或多项被违反。

paragraphs.en: We implement an immediate prior art [ 26 ] (referred to as Stage 1 in our experiments) on LLM-aided RTL repair, and provide comparative results. As seen from our experiments, the presence of assertions indeed helps the fixing task. In most cases, after Stage 1 , the LLM response is to suggest possible errors that can be present in the code. For a few cases, it is able to firmly say that this is the buggy line with a justification. Consider the case of a constant mutation inserted in the Reset block of the code, where REQ1_read is assigned 1’b1 , with all other signals assigned to 1’b0 in the reset block. In this case, the LLM is able to find the bug due to prior knowledge of the reset cycle. In some cases, as well, it is able to identify the bug, but is not able to patch it in Stage 1 . An example session is shown in Listing with one mutated line where the index of curr_offset got mutated. Listing shows the patch suggested by LLM after Stage 1 , which identifies that the bug is in the offset value, but the patch suggested produces failing assertions. At Stage 2 , when a list of failing assertions is given, the correct offset is produced (shown in Listing ), resulting in all passing assertions. This clearly demonstrates the advantage of having assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在LLM辅助的RTL修复上实现了一个即时现有技术[26]（在我们的实验中称为阶段1），并提供了对比结果。 从我们的实验可以看出，断言的存在确实有助于修复任务。 在大多数情况下，经过阶段1后，LLM的回应是建议代码中可能存在的错误。 在少数情况下，它能够明确指出这就是有缺陷的行，并给出理由。 考虑在代码的Reset块中插入常量变异的情况，其中REQ1_read被赋值为1’b1，而Reset块中所有其他信号都被赋值为1’b0。 在这种情况下，由于对复位周期的先验知识，LLM能够找到该缺陷。 在某些情况下，它也能够识别出缺陷，但在阶段1中无法对其打补丁。 一个示例会话如清单所示，其中有一行发生变异，curr_offset的索引被变异了。 清单展示了阶段1后LLM建议的补丁，它识别出缺陷在于偏移值，但所建议的补丁会产生失败的断言。 在阶段2，当给出失败断言的列表时，产生了正确的偏移量（如清单所示），使得所有断言都通过。 这清楚地展示了拥有断言的优势。

paragraphs.en: We now discuss the overall results obtained using our methodology. Table II shows the following descriptions. The first column shows the name of the module from the BRISC-V module. The second column and the third column give the number of lines of code and the number of assertions, respectively. The fourth column gives the three coverage metrics. Formal Coverage (FC): combines Stimuli Coverage (SC) and Checker Coverage (CC). An item is formally covered if it is covered by SC and CC. SC shows the reachability of the formal engines. paragraphs.en: Overall, we showed that the proposed methodology, in which the model checker aids the LLM, can be used for the bug patching of larger designs with multi-line bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们证明了所提出的方法——即由模型检测器辅助大语言模型——可用于对具有多行错误的更大规模设计进行错误修补。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we proposed the first attempt towards LLM-assisted automated RTL bug repair of single-line and multi-line bugs with assertions and a model checker in the loop. The methodology consists of two distinct steps and follows a closed-loop principle to build a context for the LLM from the assertions and the output of the model checker. Consequently, it provides a bug fix along with trustworthy grounding and formal guarantees. We used mutation testing to perform extensive experiments on BRISC-V. Our proposed method was able to fix up to 98 % 98\% of single-line RTL bugs and 93% of the multi-line bugs. The fixes were formally verified using the model checker. In addition, we believe that our methodology can be further refined to identify the few bugs that were not corrected.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们首次尝试借助断言和模型检查器（处于闭环中）实现由大语言模型辅助的自动化RTL单行与多行缺陷修复。 该方法由两个不同步骤组成，并遵循闭环原则，从断言和模型检查器的输出为大语言模型构建上下文。 因此，它不仅提供缺陷修复方案，还具备可信的依据和形式化保证。 我们使用变异测试在BRISC-V上进行了大量实验。 我们提出的方法能够修复高达98%的单行RTL缺陷以及93%的多行缺陷。 所有修复均通过模型检查器进行了形式化验证。 此外，我们相信该方法还可进一步改进，以识别那些少数未能修复的缺陷。
